Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's back escape system in eight volumes (about 7 hours), organised by which side the attacker's arms are on and what they control. Volume 1 covers the goals of both players and hand fighting. Volume 2 covers upper body escapes on the overhook side (double-over conversion, the headlock escape). Volume 3 covers lower body escapes on the overhook side (stepping over the bottom hook, countering a long hook). Volume 4 covers cross body ride escapes on the overhook side. Volume 5 covers lower body escapes on the underhook side (clearing the bottom hook, entering ashi garami). Volume 6 covers high ball ride and cross body ride escapes on the underhook side. Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls and rolling commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi players who want a complete, structured back defence.
key: Overhook-side escapes: upper body, lower body, cross body ride

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's leg lock defence course (10 files; the publisher lists 8 main sections), going through each attack and entanglement: general leg lock defence, achilles (straight ankle) locks, toe holds, outside ashi, heel hooks (the initial heel slip and second-leg interference), cross ashi, inside ashi, and a very long section on 50/50. For each one it covers prevention, escape and counter-attacks.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi grapplers who want to be safe in every leg entanglement.
key: Straight ankle and toe hold defence
Outside ashi and cross ashi escapes

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan on defending leg locks in a way that exposes the opponent's back, in eight volumes. Volume 1 covers the theory. Volume 2 covers back head-and-arm, back take / guard pass combinations and forward-roll back takes against inversions. Volume 3 covers butterfly ashi (building to standing, passing and back take options). Volume 4 covers outside ashi (back step to cross body ride). Volume 5 covers top ushiro (the 'rear' position), underhooks to back takes or passes. Volume 6 covers inside ashi (transferring to outside ashi, half roll to back step). Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: Intermediate-advanced no-gi players who want offence out of leg lock defence.
key: Defending leg locks into back takes

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: The companion to Leg Locks to Back Takes: Gordon Ryan on defending leg locks and coming out in a guard pass, eight volumes. Volume 1 covers the theory. Volume 2 covers irimi ashi (passing from top ushiro and from a defensive roll). Volumes 3 and 4 cover outside ashi defence (knee-down theory) and moving to top ushiro to pass. Volume 5 covers cross ashi (extracting the primary leg to a body lock). Volume 6 covers inside ashi (transferring to outside ashi). Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi passers who keep getting entangled.
key: Cross ashi leg extraction to body lock
